description: List or search newly noticed startups. Filter by name/website text, sector, and when Scout found them (today, 3 days, 7 days, all); sort by newest or by 7-day follower growth. Returns up to 100 companies per call plus nextCursor for the next page. Use this first for any "find/list new startups" question.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous page; omit for the first page.

query.description: Search company names and websites (e.g. "robot"). Omit to list all.

range.description: When Scout found them: 24h (today), 3d, 7d, or all (default).

sort.description: newest (default) or growth (most X followers gained over 7 days).

name: search_companies

outputSchema.description: One page of companies (up to 100) and how to fetch the next one.

items.description: A company Scout has listed: public X profile details, website metadata and funding when known.

followerGrowth7d.description: Net followers gained over the last 7 days; null until two readings a week apart exist.

followerTrend.description: Up to 8 daily follower counts, oldest first.

followers.description: Public X followers at the last scan.

foundDaysAgo.description: UTC days since Scout first noticed the company (0 = today); null for a week or more.

funding.description: Latest funding round when known. Amounts are whole USD.

latestPost.description: The account's latest public X post.

scoutUrl.description: Shareable Scout link for the company.

website.description: The website's own title and meta description.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

total.description: Companies matching the filters across all pages.

updatedAt.description: When the list last took in new data.

title: Search new startups
